name: smul_le_stoppedValue_hittingBtwn
statement: Submartingale f 𝒢 μ) {ε : ℝ≥0} (n : ℕ) : ε • μ {ω | (ε : ℝ) ≤ (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one fun k => f k ω} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ω in {ω | (ε : ℝ) ≤ (range (n + 1)).sup' nonempty_range_add_one fun k => f k ω}, stoppedValue f (fun ω ↦ (hittingBtwn f {y : ℝ | ε ≤ y} 0 n ω : ℕ)) ω ∂μ)
